current_events: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy and the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations report that an oil tanker has been damaged and caught fire off Khasab, Oman, while attempting to transit the Strait of Hormuz
The Saudi-led coalition launches airstrikes on Hodeidah, Yemen, targeting weapons smuggling used by the Houthis, and on targets in the Sanaa, Saada, and Taiz governorates
Yemeni government forces say they have conducted operations in the Al-Jawf, Marib, and Taiz governorates that have killed or injured 193 Houthi fighters

A Russian Kh-101 cruise missile strikes a field near the village of Nowy Lipowiec in Lublin Voivodeship, Poland, around 60 miles from a Coalition of the Willing training excercise. Air raid alerts are issued in Lublin and Podkarpackie Voivodeship
Violations of non-combatant airspace during the Russo-Ukrainian war
Three Salvadoran soldiers are killed and another is injured when explosives they are handling detonate
The governments of Haiti and El Salvador agree to build three new prisons to incarcerate Haitian gang members
Thirty people are killed and around 300 are missing after a ship carrying funeral goers capsizes in Bayelsa State, Nigeria

Mexican special forces arrest Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, leader of the drug cartel Los Mazatlecos and one of the United States Federal Bureau of Investigation's ten most-wanted fugitives, and two associates during an operation in Guasave, Sinaloa, triggering armed clashes with suspected cartel members
A general strike is held in Italy, with protests in multiple cities across the country

Iraqi prime minister Ali al-Zaidi announces that an agreement has been reached with Kata'ib Hezbollah to establish a joint operations center and jointly station troops in Jurf al-Sakhar, south of Baghdad, after having threatened to send Iraqi security forces into the group's stronghold
Anthropic employee and mathematician Levent Alpöge releases a claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis. The proof was created with assistance from Claude
